title: Receipt Hound
text: Receipt Hound smells unrecorded possessions and attacks the hand closest to the disputed property. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It never bites the item listed on the form.

defeatReward.text: Receipt Hound is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
